CommunityApplications.Profile: Desadius community Unraid template for the official Vacuula backend, configured for Neato Botvac D3-D7. The template follows the upstream beta channel and displays the beta and backup notices before installation. Report Unraid template issues at https://github.com/Desadius/unraid-vacuula/issues. Upstream robot and application support: https://github.com/vacuula/vacuula. This repository is independent of the upstream Vacuula project.
